about.title: About me
about.hero: Hi! I'm Javier, a technology enthusiast with a solid background in programming. I'm especially interested in software development, artificial intelligence and data management, as well as everything related to cloud deployments, API integration and CI/CD pipeline automation.
about.profileText:
I consider myself a person oriented towards continuous improvement and learning cutting-edge technologies. I really enjoy projects where architecture and code quality are a priority. I have experience working in collaborative and multidisciplinary environments, which has allowed me to develop strong communication and teamwork skills.
I created this portfolio to present myself in a more complete way and to have a place where I can store the projects I develop throughout my career and prevent them from getting lost in the GitHub black hole.

areas.webText: Building modern applications with Angular, TypeScript and REST APIs.
areas.aiText: Lightweight models, classification, embeddings and AI-driven automation.
areas.dataText: Extraction, analysis and visualization to obtain real value.
areas.cloudText: Cloud deployments, CI/CD, containers and pipeline automation.
areas.GisText: Development of web GIS libraries, integration of geospatial models and geographic data visualization.
areas.backendText: Design and development of backend services, REST APIs, business logic and database integration.

exp.uahDesc: Applied research in emerging technologies, prototyping internal tools, data management and development of small software modules for experimental studies. Collaborative work with research groups.
exp.indraDesc: Development of internal solutions, application maintenance, API integration, CI/CD pipelines and deployment support. Participation in real projects with clients and complex infrastructures.

about.projectsIntro: Some of the projects I have enjoyed working on the most:

projects.aTitle: Physical activity level detection using AI
projects.aText: Research project that collects data using custom IMUs, processes it and trains ML models to detect physical activity levels in patients. Models were later validated in real physiotherapy studies. Published paper: https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/9856513
projects.bTitle: Medical test automation with sensors and mobile app
projects.bText: Development of a mobile app connected to medical sensors to record clinical tests and store data in a central database. Integration with a web platform displaying charts, history and user roles.
projects.cTitle: Web GIS library for defense applications
projects.cText: Implementation of a web GIS library with a decoupled architecture for reuse across multiple projects. Provides geospatial abstractions and tools for defense support systems.
projects.dText: Development and deployment of an architecture for communication with smart mailboxes in the Community of Madrid, ensuring connectivity, remote management and operational reliability.

about.projectsNote: More information in the Projects section.

p2.title: AI Review Chat
p2.short: Chat that returns positive/negative sentiment for a review.
p2.long: Project where an ML model is trained on a dataset of 15,000 movie reviews to classify sentiment (positive/negative) with a confidence level. The backend is deployed in the cloud using Render's free tier.
p2.role: Designed and developed the ML model, deployment and UI

p3.title: Movie Finder (TESTING)
p3.short: Frontend that consumes a public movies API.
p3.long: App that lets you search movies, view basic details and practice pagination and error handling.

p4.title: Development Brick for a GIS Model
p4.long: Project for INDRA where a GIS model is built using the LuciadRIA engine. Includes an abstraction layer and configuration so the project can be reused across the company and avoid tight coupling.

p5.title: Physical activity level detection with AI
p5.short: Classifying physical activity levels from IMU data in patients.
p5.long: Research project where data was collected using custom IMUs placed on patients, signals were processed and cleaned, and Machine Learning models were trained to detect different physical activity levels. The models were later used in physiotherapy studies with real patients.
p5.role: Research, data processing and AI model development
p5.confidentialReason: This work involves clinical patient data in a research context, so the demo and the code are not public.

p6.title: Automating medical tests with sensors and a mobile app
p6.short: Platform to record medical tests with custom devices and web visualization.
p6.long: Work where medical tests were automated through a mobile app connected to custom devices. Data was stored in a central database and consumed by a web application with charts, test history and user role management.
p6.confidentialReason: The platform handles sensitive clinical information and does not provide a public demo.

p7.title: SIBA - Correos
p7.short: Architecture for smart mailbox communication in the Community of Madrid, deployed on AWS.
p7.long: Development and deployment of an architecture for smart mailbox communication in the Community of Madrid, integrating IoT devices with Correos' central infrastructure and ensuring connectivity, monitoring and operational reliability.
p7.confidentialReason: The solution is part of Correos' internal infrastructure and does not have a public demo or repository.
